# Fidelity report (generated by `npm run fidelity`)

Tiptap 3.32.0, extensions from `src/extensions.ts`. Input = body only (the server keeps `<head>`). "kept" = same element/attribute/text; "altered" = content survives in another form; "dropped" = gone.

| sample | kept | altered | dropped | words kept | stable after pass (per converter) | Node converters vs. real editor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| spec.html | 24 | 12 | 13 | 363/363 | browser 1st, happyDom 1st, jsdom 1st | happyDom: same, jsdom: same |
| edge-inline.html | 9 | 10 | 11 | 102/102 | browser 1st, happyDom 1st, jsdom 1st | happyDom: differs, jsdom: same |
| edge-structure.html | 14 | 10 | 11 | 125/129 | browser 2nd, happyDom 2nd, jsdom 2nd | happyDom: differs, jsdom: differs |

**Source formatting:** body 119 lines → 10 line(s) (4229 chars, line breaks only inside <pre>); comments 0 → 0; attributes 127 → 30. Prettier output: 152 lines.

**Idempotence** (HTML→Tiptap→HTML repeated):

- browser: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical
- happyDom: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical
- jsdom: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical

**Converters vs. real editor:**

- happyDom: HTML identical, JSON identical
- jsdom: HTML identical, JSON identical

**Naive mode (whole file incl. `<head>` given to setContent):** doctype/html/head/meta/title/style elements in output: none; title text leaked into body: no; CSS text leaked: no; result equals body-only round trip: yes. → `<head>` is silently discarded, so the server must keep it.

**Pretty-printing:** prettier(output) → editor → HTML equals the unformatted output (whitespace from formatting is absorbed); format→load→save→format is a fixed point. One-word edit: raw diff = 2 changed lines / 3829 chars; pretty diff = 2 changed lines / 127 chars.
